scope: CPU-only implementation review; no GPU endpoints or generation

findings.title: Managed mode does not manage GPU ownership or restore Strata
findings.evidence: Managed orchestrator probe renders once with zero lock calls and zero subprocess calls. CLI directly invokes it; no kill/free/finally-restore exists.
findings.required_fix: Wrap managed execution in the project GPU/pipeline locks, check idle queues before switching, and guarantee verified Strata restoration on success, rejection, exception and timeout.

findings.title: Existing submitted prompt is overwritten and resubmitted
findings.evidence: Existing take JSON with status=submitted and original-prompt-id was replaced by a new UUID; history was queried only for the new UUID.
findings.required_fix: Reconcile existing take metadata and prompt history before staging or submission; refuse unknown outcomes instead of generating a fresh prompt.

findings.title: Departure rule can be bypassed through an off-screen state update
findings.evidence: Validated three-beat chain: James departs; Kate-only beat changes James from missing_offscreen to inside without re_entry_cast; following beat shows James again.
findings.required_fix: Require explicit authorized re-entry for any gone-to-present actor-state transition, even when actor is offscreen in that transition; preserve established cast states.

findings.title: Zero-retry setting is ignored
findings.evidence: max_changed_retries=0 plus retry then approve produces two render calls.
findings.required_fix: Honor the configured limit and derive used attempts from persisted execution state.

findings.title: Approved-beat resume restarts at beat one
findings.evidence: Ledger loads approved after-state, but orchestrator loops from first beat; its before-state fails against committed story state.
findings.required_fix: Restore approved outputs, next unapproved beat, current guide and retry usage from persisted records; support finalization after all beats are approved.
